lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines traversing the torso. Spacing is largely equidistant with a slight increase in separation in the mid-torso region compared to the posterior and anterior clusters.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 5th line from the anterior (front) in the upper thoracic quadrant. A merger of two line segments is visible at the ventral termination of the 3rd and 4th lines from the posterior (rear).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Abbreviated segments are visible at the far posterior (1st line) and near the anterior shoulder (12th line). The 4th line from the posterior shows a distinct mid-torso gap.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7-8 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch, concentrated primarily on the lower gluteal region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lateral aspect of the hind limb align in a semi-linear diagonal formation sloping from the mid-haunch toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; large white patch visible on the lower neck/throat area; white banding present on the lower limbs above the hooves.
